Historical bridge demo capture, 2026-11-24

The unmodified historical source is f8ddbbbba211d5cb4ec6ca0a1775303ff6fce4b4.
Its first seed-5 demo capture exceeded the 120-second wall limit after
120.104 seconds, with a sampled peak of 3,226,448 KiB. It wrote no record;
that timeout is not a refusal or a geometry result.

A separate historical checkout changed only shared city mesh lookup to
index by triangle count and first and last triangles, retaining the original
full slices.Equal test and first matching prototype. The exact patch and
its equality, collision, empty, signed-zero, NaN and ownership witnesses
are part of this change. The original seed-5 hull, clumps and quick records
matched after this change. The exact optimized historical demo rows are in
historical-bridge-demo-arm64.txt. They have not been rewritten or inferred.

The same lookup change on the current source at 26f69179 produced exactly
the same two rows. The later d2d61956 topic tip did not change manufacture
code. On Darwin arm64 with go1.27.3, GOWORK=off, GOMAXPROCS=2, the bounded
capture used 120 seconds, 4 GiB sampled RSS and a 30 GiB free-disk floor:

                    seed 5             seed 11
  historical       11.368 s           5.594 s
  historical peak  3,748,512 KiB      2,325,808 KiB
  current          11.788 s           5.594 s
  current peak     3,658,656 KiB      2,412,704 KiB

The peaks are sampled, not guaranteed exact process maxima. These records
are produced by a search optimization on the historical source; the original
unoptimized demo did not complete under the bound. They must not be described
as output captured from the unmodified historical binary.
